# Progressive International Shop

> > Progressive International Shop offers kitchen storage, baking tools, and food prep gadgets under trusted brands like ProKeeper, PrepWorks, and SnapLock.

Progressive International Shop specializes in innovative kitchen organization and food preparation solutions. The store features a comprehensive catalog of baking equipment, storage containers, measuring tools, and kitchen gadgets designed for both home cooks and food enthusiasts.

## Baking Equipment & Storage

- [Baking Equipment for Transport and Prep](https://shop.progressiveintl.com/baking): Baking tools and storage solutions including ProKeeper, PrepWorks, and SnapLock products.
- [Baking Tools: Measure, Mix and Decorate](https://shop.progressiveintl.com/baking/baking-tools): PrepWorks baking tools for measuring, mixing, and decorating baked goods.
- [Baking Ingredient Containers and Travel Carriers](https://shop.progressiveintl.com/baking/storage): ProKeeper and SnapLock storage containers for ingredients and transport.
- [Keep your food Dry. Shop Dry Storage](https://shop.progressiveintl.com/baking/storage/dry-storage): ProKeeper+ dry storage containers for baking supplies and pantry organization.
- [Kitchen Storage Sets | Progressive International](https://shop.progressiveintl.com/baking/storage/sets): ProKeeper+ storage sets for kitchen organization and food preservation.
